public_rationale: Anthropic’s June 4, 2026 report describes software-task performance, coding benchmarks and reproduction of research results [e1]. It presents agents building and training models themselves as a future possibility [e1]. These results support progress toward possible recursive self-improvement, without demonstrating broad autonomous human-level capability across domains [e1].
limitations: The bounded tasks do not establish broad AGI, but they also do not establish that development automation has no relevance to eventual AGI [e1].
The report does not establish whether or when full recursive self-improvement or AGI will occur [e1].
